crossRefs.note: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be…
But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows…
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, and like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven…
The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from…
Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch…

translations.web: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.
translations.bsb: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
translations.kjv: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase
translations.asv: Let them be as chaff before the wind, And the angel of Jehovah driving them on.
